methodology: Read every actual question, full supplied history, full answer and returned citations. Compared claims, applicability and answer utility against inspected official course/program catalogs, service pages, graduate/admission pages, downloaded policies and visually checked cohort tables. During this review re-read complete AE-02/AE-05 policies, directly fetched the international-admissions dismissal condition, and re-read the2026document-guide purpose descriptions. A Schedule Letter can confirm enrollment according to the guide; its answer still needs that supporting guide citation. Model-validator/service failures are unanswered defects, not safe information gaps. Route names, evidence IDs and model verdicts are not treated as factual proof. The incremental read-only review was finalized only after completed=true/all100 and stable SHA confirmation. Source-version/private-record limitations remain in content-source-review.md.
